_comment: Regression fixture for goal issue #31: recorded `basic` scores for every file in datasets/manifest.yaml. Captured 2026-11-06 with `python scripts/eval_harness.py --manifest datasets/manifest.yaml --train` (predictions.csv, basic column). tests/test_regression_fixture.py re-scores the same files and fails if any score drifts more than `tolerance` or if an AI file no longer scores above every human file. To refresh after an intentional scoring change, re-run the harness and update the `expected` values in this file — never edit them by hand to make a failing test pass. These are synthetic smoke-fixture numbers, not an accuracy claim (see datasets/manifest.yaml).
